# Ayotech Solutions

> Ayotech Solutions — Bringing Your Ideas to Life Is Our Mission.

Ayotech Solutions provides website development, practical IT solutions, website maintenance, and graphic design and branding for businesses and individuals in Lagos, Nigeria.

## Services
- Website development: landing pages, business websites, advanced websites, and e-commerce websites.
- Search optimisation: foundational Google SEO and AI-search-friendly content structure, depending on the selected package.
- IT solutions: computer and software installation, troubleshooting, system maintenance, and website maintenance.
- Graphic design and branding: logos, brand identity, flyers, posters, business cards, social media graphics, and company profiles.
